text_block_list.text: ――One day, then two, time passes by.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Even beneath cloudy skies, her brilliance refuses to fade!
Satono Diamond claims victory in her debut race
with a sparkling final burst of speed!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Your path has begun as well.
Dia.
The strength gathered by the Umamusume bore fruit in their own ways, coloring the autumn racing season.

And as the season reaches its final stage,
even as winter approaches near the end of the year—
—The growth of the Umamusume never stops.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! Seriously?!
Don't cross the finish line before I can finish sweeping past you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Golshi-san!
Up for one more round?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Yo... how many times are you gonna run before you're satisfied!?
I'm way past my daily recommended intake of Kitasan!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doing it. Ain't no way.
Just go grab Spe or someone instead.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
! Got it!
Then next time, the three of us will race together with Spe-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey. Isn't Kitasan
actually already completely in her finished form?"
choice_data_list: No, I don't think so yet.

text_block_list.text:
I show Satono Crown the time
recorded by Kitasan Black on this day.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Wait a second, what's that about?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Why was her time better in the second half...?
There's not a single trace of fatigue in her...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...What's the strategy against Kitasan?
choice_data_list: I do have one, but it might just go to waste.

text_block_list.text:
I formulated a few strategies by referencing
Umamusume with running styles similar to Kitasan Black.

Still, I don't feel like that will work
against a "completed Kitasan Black."
choice_data_list: I think Kitasan will become the strongest frontrunner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...The strongest.

Even Satono Crown falls silent.
Kitasan Black's sheer, extraordinary power
was simply too far beyond the norm.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Then if you can use the strongest Front Runner as a reference,
would your strategy become practical?
(Screeeeeeeeech!!)

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome to Hong Kong, Crown!
(Welcome to Hong Kong, Crown!)"

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
妳request嘅嗰位對手都嚟咗喎♪
(The rival you requested is here too♪)

text_block_list.name: GⅠ Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet ya.
(Nice to meet you~)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Do you know her too, Trainer?
She's the girl who won a Hong Kong International GⅠ this year!
Of course I know her; she's an Umamusume who has found success not just in Hong Kong, but in America and France as well.

Traversing countries, always entering top-class races overseas.
Over 7 million followers on social media...
In any case, definitely not someone you can just invite casually!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we all have a mock race then?
I've already booked the track♪

The Umamusume quickly finish their warm-ups one after another.
That GⅠ Umamusume is no exception...

text_block_list.name: GⅠ Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Heh—

Without feeling the heaviness underfoot even on European turf,
she runs with leisurely ease, utilizing her entire body with supple grace.
Running ahead of the other Umamusume with practiced ease even during warm-ups—is that a display of confidence forged from dominating with a 'front-runner' style?

text_block_list.name: Older Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, the gate's ready!
(All right, the gate is ready~!) "

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Hey, hey, wait a sec.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell me a few of those strategies
against Kitasan you mentioned earlier?
choice_data_list: Are you going to give it a try?
Are you going to try it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
That's what the guests are for, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Let's fine-tune our strategy to see what kind of tactics will work against the strongest front runner.

"Strategy number one:
Stick right on her tail."

text_block_list.name: GⅠ Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't quite keep up, huh?
(Couldn't keep up with my pace, could you?♪)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right...

"Strategy number two:
Hold a position at the front of the back pack.
Then drag everyone into a long spurt midway through."

text_block_list.name: GⅠ Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I win!
(I'm the winner~)"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
But it was closer this time!
(It was much closer than before, though!)

After that, taking breaks and trying across different days,
we tested out various strategies in mock races
featuring GⅠ Umamusume.

Pacesetter, Betweener, Chaser.
Trying every position,
trying every strategy—

text_block_list.name: GⅠ Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I've just had plans come in,
so this race'll be our last.
(Something just came up~. One more run and we're done!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: What?!

With no decisive plan among all the options,
the final day arrived all too quietly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Trainer, the next plan is—
choice_data_list: Wait for me, next up is—

text_block_list.text:
Flipping through the notebook filled with strategies.
Finally, the one thing we haven't tried yet is...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: GⅠ Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Not going to run?
(Aren't you going to run?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I am! It's just...
(I'll run! But――)"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, after you gave me such a great chance...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...That's no good, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"You're forgetting
that there's still a strategy we haven't tried, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Always securing the optimal position, then
slicing through the field all at once with a late burst of speed.
Running like that is practically my signature.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...We both became so used to adorning ourselves with the strategies you gave us that we forgot, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Even without wrapping myself in strategy, my intuition and body
have been thoroughly forged by you."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —So, why not try Satono Crown's raw running style—the one you first fell in love with?

text_block_list.name: GⅠ Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Ready, then?
(Are you ready?)"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Ready. Let's do this!
(I'm ready. Let's go!)"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Believe in our hard work.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhh!!

Satono Crown surges forward.
—Stepping into a battle among the top tier with nothing but her own body.
At that moment, I finally felt like I had reached the world.

text_block_list.name: GⅠ Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's so unfair, the way you
can close out a race.
(That final sprint of yours is what I hate the most.)

text_block_list.name: GⅠ Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Your late surge is unreal.
(...Man, your late surge is incredible.)"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
!
—Right?

“......To come all this way.
No, it's precisely because I made it this far that I finally understand.”

"The peak world is where those gather who have exhausted all strategies and preparations.
To sink one's teeth into the throat of such an opponent—"
choice_data_list: (Only the weapons I can truly believe in.)

text_block_list.text:
For instance,
a storm-like pressure that blows away everything around her.
Bottomless tenacity.

The blades of true elites that can cut down even the first-rate
will easily shatter such half-baked, superficial skills.
choice_data_list: (Because everyone will be fully prepared when competing for the top.)

text_block_list.text:
"Then on our side, we need a weapon we can believe in from the bottom of our hearts.
Something that has always been her core."
choice_data_list: (The talent I fell for in her—I'll forge it into a blade)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Was racing... always something
this pure and primitive?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"To bring down the unbeatable strength they boast,
I have no choice but to throw my own absolute best against them—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
They praised my late spurt.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To claim victory from here on, we must hone this weapon to absolute perfection.
Did you... think the same thing?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Can I make these legs—the ultimate finishing kick?
—The 'strongest late-stage kick'.
Those words overlapped the image of "that Umamusume" with Satono Crown.
